summary: Demo Bank plans to introduce an automated, end-to-end digital consumer loan product within its mobile banking application for existing salary-domiciled customers. Eligible applicants can configure their loan amount up to 1,000,000 ALL and select a repayment term with real-time monthly instalment calculation before submitting. Approved applicants receive immediate same-day disbursement into their current account, while applicants with adverse credit history are automatically declined.

business_rules.rule: The consumer loan application and disbursement must be delivered entirely online through the mobile banking application.
business_rules.source_quote: Demo Bank wants to launch a fully online consumer loan in the mobile app.

business_rules.rule: Only customers who receive their salary into an account held at Demo Bank are eligible to apply.
business_rules.source_quote: Customers whose salary is paid into Demo Bank can apply for a loan up to 1,000,000 ALL.

business_rules.rule: The maximum permissible loan amount per application is 1,000,000 ALL.
business_rules.source_quote: Customers whose salary is paid into Demo Bank can apply for a loan up to 1,000,000 ALL.

business_rules.rule: The customer must select the requested loan principal and loan term, and the system must display the calculated monthly instalment prior to application submission.
business_rules.source_quote: The customer chooses the amount and the term, sees the monthly instalment and submits the application.

business_rules.rule: Credit underwriting decisions must be fully automated without requiring manual underwriter intervention.
business_rules.source_quote: The decision should be automatic and the money should arrive in the customer's current account the same day.

business_rules.rule: Disbursement of approved loan funds must be credited to the customer's current account on the same calendar day as the approval.
business_rules.source_quote: The decision should be automatic and the money should arrive in the customer's current account the same day.

business_rules.rule: Customers identified with a bad credit history must be disqualified and rejected from obtaining the loan.
business_rules.source_quote: Customers with a bad credit history should not get the loan.

open_questions.question: What criteria verify that 'salary is paid into Demo Bank' (e.g., specific transaction code, minimum monthly amount, consecutive months such as 3 or 6 months)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without an objective data definition, customers with irregular deposits or one-off transfers might falsely qualify or genuine salary earners might be locked out.

open_questions.question: What are the minimum and maximum boundaries for loan term (e.g., 6 to 60 months) and minimum loan amount (e.g., 20,000 ALL)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The UI cannot configure sliders or validation rules without explicit boundaries and increments.

open_questions.question: How is 'bad credit history' precisely defined (e.g., external credit bureau score cutoff, maximum days past due in the Credit Registry, internal write-offs)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The automated decision engine requires programmatic scoring thresholds; ambiguity leads to inconsistent credit risk assessment.

open_questions.question: What is the maximum allowed Debt-Service-to-Income (DSTI) ratio, and how are existing internal and external debt obligations retrieved and calculated?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Lending up to 1,000,000 ALL without verifying DSTI could violate central bank responsible lending regulations and increase defaults.

open_questions.question: Where and how is explicit customer consent obtained for querying the national Credit Registry/Bureau and processing personal credit data?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Pulling credit bureau data without verifiable digital consent breaches GDPR/data privacy laws and banking regulations.

open_questions.question: What is the same-day cut-off time for automated disbursement, and what occurs if an application is submitted or approved after this cut-off or on non-business days?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Core banking batch windows or end-of-day clearing cut-offs may delay posting to the next calendar day, violating the same-day rule.

open_questions.question: What specific decline screen and explanation are displayed to rejected customers, what remains unchanged on their account, and what is the reapplication cooling-off period?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Unclear rejection UX causes customer frustration, high support call volumes, and repeated immediate re-submissions.

open_questions.question: What step-up authentication (e.g., biometrics, OTP, PIN) and device binding are required before loan agreement signing and fund disbursement?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Account takeover (ATO) fraud could allow an attacker with temporary mobile access to disburse 1,000,000 ALL instantly and exfiltrate funds.

risks.description: Failure to capture legally binding digital consent prior to querying the credit bureau exposes the bank to regulatory penalties and customer lawsuits.
Automated lending without DSTI validation or debt verification across external lenders could result in systemic over-indebtedness and elevated non-performing loans (NPLs).
Compromised mobile banking sessions or device theft could enable unauthorized parties to accept pre-approved loans and transfer funds immediately (Account Takeover).
External credit bureau downtime or API latency could leave applications hung in an indeterminate state, breaking the instant automated decisioning promise.
Lack of standardized payroll transaction tagging in core banking could lead to false-negative eligibility evaluations for customers receiving legitimate salary via interbank wire.
Cut-off time bottlenecks in core banking clearing might prevent same-day posting for applications approved late in the evening.

stories.i_want: the app to evaluate whether my salary history at Demo Bank qualifies me for the consumer loan
stories.so_that: I can only access the application if I fulfill basic banking relationship criteria
stories.source_quote: Customers whose salary is paid into Demo Bank can apply for a loan up to 1,000,000 ALL.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer has an active mobile banking profile and has verified salary credits meeting criteria defined in Q-1
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer navigates to the loan section in the mobile app
acceptance_criteria.then: the app permits the customer to start a new consumer loan application.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer does not have verified salary credits in Demo Bank according to Q-1
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer attempts to access the loan section
acceptance_criteria.then: access to the loan application is blocked, and an informative message is displayed explaining the salary domicile requirement while leaving existing accounts unchanged.

stories.i_want: to select a loan amount up to 1,000,000 ALL and choose a repayment term to view the calculated monthly instalment
stories.so_that: I can evaluate affordability before formally applying
stories.source_quote: The customer chooses the amount and the term, sees the monthly instalment and submits the application.

acceptance_criteria.given: an eligible customer configuring a loan
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer inputs an amount between the minimum limit defined in Q-2 and 1,000,000 ALL and selects a valid term
acceptance_criteria.then: the system calculates and displays the exact monthly instalment, interest rate, and total repayment amount in real time.

acceptance_criteria.given: an eligible customer configuring a loan
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer attempts to input an amount strictly greater than 1,000,000 ALL
acceptance_criteria.then: the system blocks the input, sets the maximum allowed value to 1,000,000 ALL, and displays a validation error.

stories.i_want: to submit my completed loan application with explicit credit bureau consent
stories.so_that: my credit history can be checked automatically without visiting a branch
stories.source_quote: The customer chooses the amount and the term, sees the monthly instalment and submits the application.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer has configured their amount and term and provided mandatory credit check consent per Q-5
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer taps the Submit Application button
acceptance_criteria.then: the application is submitted for automated processing and the customer sees a processing indicator.

stories.i_want: the decision engine to automatically decline applicants with bad credit history
stories.so_that: the bank does not extend credit to high-risk borrowers
stories.source_quote: Customers with a bad credit history should not get the loan.

acceptance_criteria.given: a submitted application where external credit bureau checks or internal records return bad credit status based on thresholds in Q-3
acceptance_criteria.then: the application status is set to Rejected automatically without manual review, and the customer is presented with a formal decline notice per Q-7 without opening any loan account.

stories.i_want: the approved loan funds to be deposited automatically into my current account on the same day
stories.so_that: I have immediate access to my funds
stories.source_quote: The decision should be automatic and the money should arrive in the customer's current account the same day.

acceptance_criteria.given: an application has received automated approval before the daily cut-off time defined in Q-6
acceptance_criteria.when: the loan contract is confirmed via step-up authentication per Q-8
acceptance_criteria.then: the loan account is opened and the full principal is credited to the customer's Demo Bank current account on the same calendar day.

uat_cases.title: Eligibility check - Customer without salary domiciliation
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer logged into mobile app; no salary payments credited to Demo Bank account in the past 6 months.
steps: Navigate to 'Loans' or 'Apply for Loan' screen
uat_cases.expected_result: Application start is blocked; screen informs customer that a salary account with Demo Bank is required. No loan account created.

uat_cases.title: Eligibility check - Customer with active salary domiciliation
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer logged into mobile app; regular monthly salary credited to Demo Bank account meeting Q-1 rules.
uat_cases.expected_result: Loan calculator screen opens successfully, allowing customer to choose amount and term.

uat_cases.title: Loan amount boundary - Maximum limit exact (1,000,000 ALL)
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer on the loan configuration screen.
steps: Input exactly 1,000,000 ALL as loan amount
uat_cases.expected_result: Amount is accepted; monthly instalment is calculated and displayed accurately.

uat_cases.title: Loan amount boundary - Just below maximum limit (999,999 ALL)
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer on the loan configuration screen.
steps: Input 999,999 ALL (or nearest allowed step below maximum) as loan amount
uat_cases.expected_result: Amount is accepted; monthly instalment updates accurately.

uat_cases.title: Loan amount boundary - Just above maximum limit (1,000,001 ALL)
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer on the loan configuration screen.
steps: Attempt to enter 1,000,001 ALL manually in the loan amount field
uat_cases.expected_result: Field caps at 1,000,000 ALL or validation error appears: 'Maximum loan amount cannot exceed 1,000,000 ALL'. Cannot proceed.

uat_cases.title: Loan submission with mandatory consent
uat_cases.preconditions: Eligible customer with valid amount (500,000 ALL) and term (12 months) selected.
steps: Check credit bureau consent checkbox per Q-5
uat_cases.expected_result: Application submits successfully; loading/processing state is shown while automated decision runs.

uat_cases.title: Automated decline - Customer with bad credit history
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer has salary domiciled at Demo Bank but has active default recorded in credit registry per Q-3.
uat_cases.expected_result: Decision engine returns decline within seconds; mobile app displays rejection screen as per Q-7; current account balance and existing products remain unchanged.

uat_cases.title: Automated approval and same-day current account disbursement
uat_cases.preconditions: Eligible customer with clean credit history; application submitted before daily cut-off time (Q-6).
steps: Authenticate loan acceptance via step-up credential per Q-8
uat_cases.expected_result: Loan contract is generated; 500,000 ALL is credited to current account immediately on the same calendar day; updated current account balance reflects funds.
